from appworld.common.finders import find_all_from_pages
from appworld.common.math import sum_of

# Assume main_user, apis, relation, direction, start_date are defined.
phone_tok = apis.phone.access_token_from(main_user)
contacts = find_all_from_pages(apis.phone.search_contacts, access_token=phone_tok,
                               query=relation, relationship=relation)
venmo_tok = apis.venmo.access_token_from(main_user)
total = 0
for contact in contacts:
    kwargs = dict(access_token=venmo_tok, min_created_at=start_date,
                  user_email=contact.email)
    if direction in ("sent", "received"):
        kwargs["direction"] = direction
    txns = find_all_from_pages(apis.venmo.show_transactions, **kwargs)
    total += sum_of(txns, "amount")
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=total, status="success")
